verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair privacy question for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, data collection, or any opt-out setting, nor documents that the product collects no telemetry. The config docs cover appearance, IPC, env vars and similar settings but say nothing on this subject.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
